function: Multi-agent DRL selects RIS partition beams, number of RIS partitions, UE receive-beam codewords and NOMA power allocation to maximize the sum rate without CSI (p. 3).
system: Downlink single-cell MIMO-NOMA: BS and UEs with 16-element phased arrays, reflecting 1-bit RIS of 400 elements in partitions, 28 GHz mmWave, 2 to 4 UEs (p. 11, 12).
method: Multi-agent reinforcement learning: DDQN agent per UE for beams, DDPG actor-critic agent with KNN for RIS partitions and power; shared reward from RSSI feedback (p. 9).
data_channel: Measured RSSI matrices from own 28 GHz RIS testbed (UE on a rover, 3 to 6 m away), no CSI; used for training and evaluation (p. 1, 12).
test_conditions: Trained and tested in the same testbed environment; each figure fixes power, QoS, fairness, UE count (2 to 4) and partitions; transfer learning not implemented (p. 12, 14).
baselines: Exhaustive search; proposed method without partitioning; single-agent DRL PPO, DDQN, DDPG, SAC; Multi-DDQN and Multi-DDPG (p. 12, 14, 15).
metrics: Total and per-UE sum rate, FLOPs, average rate over training episodes, standard deviation of the reward (p. 12, 13, 15).
complexity: Exhaustive search about 3x10^9 FLOPs versus about 4x10^7 FLOPs per agent for three agents; Big-O training and inference cost per agent also given (p. 10, 13).
openness: None stated for code or data; only an IEEE supplementary-material note at https://doi.org/10.1109/OJCOMS.2025.3624260 without a description of its content (p. 1).
q1_support: p. 1: "gather real-world data for training and evaluation" - measured RSSI from the authors' own mmWave RIS testbed (p. 10); no standardized channel model is used.
q2_support: p. 14: "While the current work does not explicitly implement" transfer learning; the figures sweep power, QoS, fairness, UEs and partitions, and no trained model is tested in an unseen scenario.
q3_support: p. 15: "MA-DRL framework with different DRL baselines (PPO," - sum rate against PPO, DDQN, DDPG and SAC in Fig. 12; against exhaustive search in Fig. 5 (p. 12).
q4_support: p. 13: "requiring approximately 4 × 107 FLOPs (including both" - three agents of about 4x10^7 FLOPs each against about 3x10^9 for exhaustive search; Big-O analysis in Section III-D (p. 10).
q5_support: p. 10: "data consists only of RSSI matrices, while CSI is not" - measured data from the authors' testbed; no link to data or code is given, only the supplementary-material note on p. 1.
notes: Included, area 3: the learned method picks RIS phase-shift codewords and partitions, UE receive beams and NOMA power in a RIS-aided link, which is RIS configuration and beamforming. Tables 1 to 3 and the figures are not in the extracted text, so I read them from the page images (pp. 3, 4, 11 to 15). q1 and q5 rest on the measured-data clause: the RSSI data come from the authors' own testbed and no dataset link is given; the p. 1 note on supplementary material does not say what it holds, so the reviewer should confirm that clause for q5. PPO and SAC are the learned baselines of q3; DDQN, DDPG, Multi-DDQN and Multi-DDPG overlap with modules of the proposed method. The paper reports its numerical results from the testbed (p. 4).
